description: This Java class 'TenantObject' encapsulates tenant information for the Eclipse Hono project, including properties, trust anchors, adapter configurations, resource limits, and tracing settings. It provides methods for managing tenant data, trust anchors, and adapter configurations, with JSON serialization annotations.

classes.name: TenantObject
classes.description: Represents tenant information including properties, trust anchors, adapter configurations, resource limits, and tracing settings, with JSON serialization support.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Adds a property to the tenant object, supporting command chaining.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant's identifier.

methods.name: setTenantId
methods.description: Sets the tenant's identifier.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the tenant.

methods.name: setTrustAnchor
methods.description: Sets a trust anchor with a public key and subject DN.

methods.name: getTrustAnchor
methods.description: Returns the first trust anchor (deprecated).

methods.name: getTrustAnchors
methods.description: Returns the set of trust anchors, creating them from JSON data if necessary.

methods.name: getTrustAnchorForPublicKey
methods.description: Creates a TrustAnchor object from JSON properties containing public key info.

methods.name: getAdapterConfigurationsAsMaps
methods.description: Returns adapter configurations as a list of maps.

methods.name: getAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Returns adapter configurations as a JsonArray.

methods.name: getAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific adapter type.

methods.name: setAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Sets adapter configurations from a list of maps.

methods.name: setAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Sets adapter configurations from a JsonArray.

methods.name: addAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a single adapter configuration.

methods.name: isAdapterEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific adapter is enabled.

methods.name: getMaxTimeUntilDisconnect
methods.description: Returns max seconds until disconnect for an adapter.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a TenantObject with tenantId and enabled status.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a TenantObject with enabled status.

methods.name: newAdapterConfig
methods.description: Creates new adapter configuration properties.

methods.name: getResourceLimits
methods.description: Returns resource limits for the tenant.

methods.name: setResourceLimits
methods.description: Sets resource limits from a JsonObject.

methods.name: setResourceLimits
methods.description: Sets resource limits from a ResourceLimits object.

methods.name: getMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Returns minimum message size in bytes.

methods.name: setMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Sets minimum message size in bytes.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns default properties for devices.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default properties for devices.

methods.name: getTracingConfig
methods.description: Returns tracing configuration.

methods.name: setTracingConfig
methods.description: Sets tracing configuration.
